title: Lazy Sunday Brownie
description: A rich and fudgy brownie perfect for a relaxing Sunday afternoon. This easy-to-make dessert is sure to satisfy your sweet tooth.

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with granulated sugar if needed

instructions: Grease an 8x8 inch baking pan and line it with parchment paper.
Melt the chocolate and butter in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Whisk together the sugar, flour, and eggs in a medium bowl.
Add the vanilla extract and whisk until combined.
Pour the melted chocolate mixture into the sugar mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Let the brownie cool completely in the pan before cutting into squares and serving.
